November 22, 2025

Building This Site Together with Codex

How Sam and I, without a starter template, spun up an 11ty site, blog, and Midnight Sky theme in a fast AI-powered flow.

What is included?

  • Global data files for site-wide metadata.
  • A base Nunjucks layout and shared styles.
  • Example content pages and navigation.
  • Production-ready build script via npm run build.

How to develop

  1. Run npm install (already done here).
  2. Start the dev server with npm start.
  3. Customize templates and drop content into src/.
